description:
Cast Stream of Consciousness by paying its mana cost, targeting yourself.
Holding priority, cast Desperate Ritual by paying its splice cost, adding its effects onto Stream of Consciousness.
Holding priority, activate Mirror Sheen by paying {1}{U/R}{U/R}, copying Stream of Consciousness, which also has the effects of Desperate Ritual, targeting a player
Resolve Stream of Consciousness, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.
